# All Good Test Skill

Use this skill when you need to verify that quality linting correctly passes skills without any quality issues.

This skill has:
- A reasonable body length (under 5000 words)
- A reasonable file length (under 500 lines)
- A description between 40 and 1024 characters
- No XML tags in the description
- Forward slash paths only
- Clear "when to use" signal
- A name that is not a reserved word

This is the ideal scenario for a well-crafted skill that should pass all quality checks.
